g.text: A FOK sums before it touches anything, so it fills all or none
the BBO core checks the whole quantity at the cut, then executes or rejects
step s: sum the fillable qty, at the cut,
over the levels within the limit, without
sum ≥ qty → execute as a Cross (§6.5)
all or none: a FOK that
Budget: as for a cross, 880 ns. The unfillable case uses Reject FOK_UNFILLABLE (01 §14.10).
